metadata.description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: one /task workflow plus stack check plugins (frontend, supabase, server).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Backlog-driven work loop as one skill: /task create, /task start, /task end. Chains Backlog.md, Anthropic feature-dev, and superpowers, and calls the *-start-check / *-end-check skills of enabled stack plugins.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend checks for /task start and /task end: common checks plus Svelte and React references picked by detecting the project, browser testing, and review agents ui-reviewer, svelte-reviewer, react-reviewer.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Supabase checks for /task start and /task end (migrations, drift, RLS, types, keys) and the rls-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: server
plugins.description: Backend checks for /task start and /task end: common checks plus Node, Python, Go, and Java/Kotlin references picked by detecting the project (install, LSP, migrations, API contract, real calls), and the api-reviewer agent.
